Dragon's Crown.question: The Vita and PS3 versions were respectively the first and second best-selling digital games on PSN in _____ during 2013
Dragon's Crown.fact: Dragon's Crown had sold more than 300,000 physical retail units in Japan within the first week of release across both PS3 and Vita platforms. The Vita and PS3 versions were respectively the first and second best-selling digital games on PSN in Japan during 2013.

Dragon's Crown.question: By December 2013, the game had shipped 800,000 units worldwide, 100,000 units more than Atlus's _____ 4 Golden
Dragon's Crown.fact: By December 2013, the game had shipped 800,000 units worldwide, 100,000 units more than Atlus's Persona 4 Golden.
